newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent stalled in range, seeks direction.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent stalled in range, seeks direction.

text.p: Brent crude futures were untraded on SIMEX around midday on Tuesday as global crude futures hovered around overnight levels.
July Brent was quoted at $19.45/$19.56 per barrel, after London rose 12 cents overnight to settle at $19.52.
NYMEX July crude, which gained 10 cents overnight to $20.98, was last traded on the after-hours ACCESS system at $20.99 -- just one cent higher.
Brokers said both Brent and NYMEX were lethargic and were struggling for fresh impetus.
SIMEX was likely to reflect that lethargy until a new direction became more apparent.
For the time being, traders said July Brent was confined to a range of $19.10 to $19.88, reflecting the last cyclical low and the lower end of a five-cent chart gap up to $19.93, respectively.
